description.narrative: The project is expected to have positive environmental effects by replacing thermal energy sources with renewable energy sources thus reducing emissions from the power sector. IFC anticipates that the proposed expansion of the Solar PV plant will result in GHG emission savings of 61,461tCO2e annually. Additionally, the Project will improve the resilience of Perus energy system by increasing its share of RE and supporting the adoption of BESS which enables the integration of RE into the energy mix, effectively reducing dependency on fossil fuels. The Project which supports the construction and development of a 26.5 MWh BESS located in the Lima region, the largest in the country, is expected to have significant demonstration effects illustrating the role of large-scale BESS adoption in accelerating RE deployment.

The proposed investment consists of an unsecured corporate facility of up to US$600 million (up to US$250 million from IFC's own account and up to US $350 million mobilization) to ENGIE Energia Peru S.A. (EEP or the Company), to support the Company in achieving its transformational non-conventional renewable energy (NCRE) target for the next five years. The facility will be structured as Sustainability Linked Loan and the first loan of the facility has a total amount of US$ 120 million. The proceeds of the loan will (i) refinance the investment to acquire Duna and Huambos, two operating wind farms of 36.8MW in total, (ii) finance the development and construction of a 51.4 MW solar plant expansion, Intipampa, and (iii) refinance the development and construction of a 26.5MW BESS, currently under operation.
